prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer.
Asset: transparent avatar in an existing Ukrainian board-game gouache cat portrait series.
Input images: image 1 is the ONLY human identity/clothing reference for Єгор. Image 2 supplies ONLY the approved gouache/pencil style, feline transformation and bust framing. Do not copy image 2's large long quiff, sharp jaw, eye color or black printed shirt.
Primary request: reimagine the person in image 1 as a recognizable anthropomorphic CAT. Preserve short medium-brown hair with light brown tips, cropped short sides, irregular short fringe and a small tousled spiky tuft rising on image-right. Preserve the broad gently oval face and soft cheeks, fairly straight thick dark eyebrows, natural brown eyes and their spacing, friendly calm direct gaze and gentle closed-mouth smile. Keep faint short chin/jaw stubble as subtle darker short fur, no thick beard or moustache.
Anatomy: actual small cat nose, short natural feline muzzle, fine whiskers, warm muted taupe/chestnut fur with cream cheek/muzzle highlights. EXACTLY TWO ears TOTAL: pointed feline ears on TOP, fully visible. NO human ears, lower side ears or fleshy lobes; eye-level sides are continuous fur rather than original human ear outlines.
Clothing: light gray sweatshirt with a high softly folded mock/turtleneck collar and visible shoulder seams, modest fully clothed upper bust, no zipper or hoodie, no lettering or logos.
Style: warm textured hand-painted gouache and colored-pencil picture-book board-game rendering, softly dimensional painted fur, warm imperfect deep-brown/deep-green contours, ivory highlights. Neutral soft warm light, remove purple wall color cast.
Composition: square single centered nearly frontal head-and-upper-torso bust, relaxed direct-facing pose, generous transparent margins on ALL FOUR sides, ear tips completely inside canvas with visible clear space above, rounded shoulder silhouette at bottom.
Background: genuine native transparent alpha. Remove purple wall, room and all background. No other characters, props, scene, text, circle badge, frame or watermark.
